Name: Yandere Samantha Dialogue Expansion
Author: VileBeggar
Description:
[center][size=4][b]This is a fork of Amaryn12's [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6018]Yandere Sam Dialogue[/url][b].[/b][/size][/center]﻿
My fork of the mod focuses on changing dialogue for compatibility with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2941]Combined Girl Mod[/url]﻿. Yandere Samantha's dialogue assumes you are playing with a female Sam, female Sebastian, and female Alex at the bare minimum.

[size=4][b]Key differences:[/b][/size]

While I did enjoy the original dialogue of the Yandere Sam Dialogue mod, I toned down a majority of the more raunchy lines. I also lowered Sam's murderhobo tendencies down a decent amount. While the tendency still appears, it's to a lesser extent. My goal was for Sam to sound more possessive and controlling rather than psychotic. Though, some remnants of said personality still shines through. This should be reflected in the festival dialogue, if you've played the original mod.

I also spent an afternoon reading Event modding guides to further my own understanding of the game. My effort has resulted in two simple new heart events for Sam. One event can be found at heart level 2 around 9 pm if you take the northern backwoods entrance to your farm on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday. The other event triggers at heart level 6 at Sam's house around 7 pm during a rainy day.

Note: Most new dialogue shows up at key heart milestones. You may not see new dialogue unless you are at exactly 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10 hearts.

[size=4][b]Bugs:
[/b][/size]
Do not bother Amaryn12 with any bug reports for this mod. In the event of a red error related to this mod, please share your SMAPI logs. Provide screenshots for any strange wording, spelling errors, or other text inconsistency encountered with the mod.

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2941]Combined Girl Mod[/url] (Partial Requirement): Turn the bachelors into females. You can possibly use other mods to do this as well.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3312]
MissCoriel's NPC Unique Courtship Response 4 - Happy Birthday[/url]: Some new dialogue was added for giving Sam a birthday gift, mermaid pendant, and flowers.

[b]WARNING:[/b] You must configure Unique Courtship Responses for Sam by opening the Unique Courtship mod folder, opening the config file, and setting Sam to disabled.

[size=4][b]Recommendation:[/b][/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/url]: I developed the events and edited some dialogue lines with the expressions from the female Sam from this portrait mod in mind.
[size=4][b]
FAQ:[/b][/size][size=3]

[b]Is this compatible with other dialogue mods?[/b][/size]

It depends on the load order of the other dialogue mods. Dialogue mods load in alphabetical order within your mods folder. For example, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Stardew Valley Dialogue Expansion[/url] loads before Yandere Sam so Yandere Sam will overwrite any conflicting dialogue slots.

[b][size=3]Why is the CombinedGirlMod listed as a false dependency in the Manifest?[/size]
[/b]
It's a trick to force CombinedGirlMod to load before Yandere Sam without changing the mod file names. I did this because the new Introduction line for Sam was being overwritten by CombinedGirlMod. Yes, you could technically do this to force overwrite other dialogue mods.
[b]
[size=3]Is this compatible with other Yandere mods?[/size]
[/b]
[url=https://youtu.be/QrGrOK8oZG8]Too many cooks[/url], technically yes though. They will run together, but there will likely be bizarre results. For example, my Yandere Sabrina fork has Sam say a few lines throughout the year about Sabrina's odd behavior. This mod has Sabrina talk about Sam's odd behavior. Their dialogue might "conflict" with their new personalities.

I might make a variant with tweaked dialogue for both Yandere mods at some point. Although, these days I prefer thelittlefae's fork of Yandere Sebastian ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8108]Possessive Sebastian/Sabrina[/url]) over my own.
